type_dialect.reviewed_rule: Treat single-choice and multiple-choice as choice-family labels only when options are a list with at least2strings and every target is a legal integer index; this sample has exactly1target perrow.

option_whitespace.rule: str.strip on each entire option, with order/length/content otherwise identical; no rematching or sample change.
